title: If statements
syllabusDesc: Branch logic with if, elif, and else.
desc: Branch with if / elif / else to handle thresholds or choices.

challenges.title: Grade classifier
challenges.prompt: Given a score, print A for 90+, B for 80+, C for 70+, else "Retake". Use if/elif/else.

challenges.title: Even or odd
challenges.prompt: Read a number from input() and print "even" if divisible by 2, else "odd".

challenges.title: Ticket pricing
challenges.prompt: Set price based on age: under 5 -> 0, under 18 -> 8, else 12. Print the price.

challenges.title: Max of two numbers
challenges.prompt: Given a and b, print the larger number without using max().
